revision_history.review_request: Restore missing detailed library as a dedicated reproducible asset; replace generic two-story massing cues with current building-specific source evidence.
geometry_edits: Kept the estimated 6.2 m one-story service shell and the official GIS FID 408 footprint/origin.
Added the photo-visible reception-frontage window row, a recessed entry, a raised brick reception volume, and a four-sided tile hip roof over the reception wing.
Removed unsupported generic facade piers and tall rooftop stacks/screens, and added the source-visible right-return louver. Service-door and architectural dimensions remain estimates.
revision_history.source_interpretation: Purdue BEP photo pixels directly support the reception window row, raised brick entry wing, four-sided clay-tile hip, recessed double-door portal, service bay and right-return louver. Rooftop detail remains restrained because the Farm Animal Hospital is mostly cropped in the available aerial.
